svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 06: A module’s settings explain themselves
svg.text: Food → Settings: the right control for each field (switch, chips, stepper, a field only for free text), a help line under each, the default said, one save bar.
Use case: an organiser who has never seen Food’s settings sets it up for tonight without guessing what to type (1280 px and 390 px)

g.text: Off closes the Food page to new orders; open orders go on.
Shown on the Food page while ordering is off.
Anyone at the event, or only the crew.
1 to 20 · default 1. Two lets two pizzerias run side by side.
Pizzas per person in one order
When on, the holder can choose this per order. Default off.
Attendees get a last call this long before ordering closes.
The holder gets a nudge if nothing moves. Default 15 min.
At the turn of the event day, open orders close.
AI reader · off · read receipts and menus for the crew

svg.text: A · 1280 px: groups as declared, each field a row of label, help line and control; free text only for the note

g.text: Off closes the Food page to new orders
Shown on the Food page while ordering is off.
Anyone at the event, or only the crew.
Pizzas per person in one order
When on, the holder can choose this per order
Attendees get a last call this long before ordering closes.
The holder gets a nudge if nothing moves
At the turn of the event day, open orders close.

svg.text: B · 390 px: label, help line, then the control

g.text: Off closes the Food page to new orders
Shown on the Food page while ordering is off.
Anyone at the event, or only the crew.
Pizzas per person in one order
When on, the holder can choose this per order
Attendees get a last call this long before ordering closes.
The holder gets a nudge if nothing moves
At the turn of the event day, open orders close.
Other: pick any time from 1 to 60 min
Steps of 5 min · hold to go faster

svg.text: C · “Other” opens a stepper, never a blank box
Notes: help lines, examples and choices come from the module’s declarations, which #732 extends (L3, L4).
The same form draws in every module’s Settings tab; values and saving stay admin’s (D3).
